title: Klotski: Efficient Mixture-of-Expert Inference via Expert-Aware Multi-Batch Pipeline
problem: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs with trillion-scale parameters must be offloaded to CPU/disk memory when GPU VRAM is insufficient, but each expert's compute time per token is shorter than the I/O time to load it, creating large pipeline bubbles that negate the benefit of overlapping I/O and computation.
motivation: MoE models enable parameter scaling without proportional compute growth, but their sparse expert activation makes the offloading compute-to-I/O ratio unfavorable, bottlenecking inference throughput on commodity hardware.
method: Klotski processes multiple requests in parallel instead of one at a time. When different requests' computations need the same expert module (a specialized part of the trillion-parameter model), Klotski groups those token computations together, making the total work on that module long enough to keep the GPU busy while loading it from disk into fast memory—eliminating idle processor gaps. The system predicts which expert modules upcoming requests will use and pre-loads them, while also deciding which computations to run next, balancing the load across the memory bus and GPU processors so both operate at full capacity.
key_novelty: Klotski groups token computations from multiple concurrent requests that target the same expert module, making the computation work long enough to fully hide the time spent loading that module.
contributions: Analysis of the compute-I/O imbalance bottleneck in offloaded MoE inference and the pipeline bubble problem.
Klotski expert-aware multi-batch pipeline that co-schedules I/O prefetch and compute across concurrent batches.
Significant throughput improvement for trillion-parameter MoE inference on memory-constrained hardware.

metrics.other: pipeline bubble reduction for offloaded MoE inference

limitations: Multi-batch pipelining increases request latency per batch since batches wait for others; not discussed explicitly.
primary_theme: multi-batch expert-aware scheduling for offloaded MoE inference
